sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicants submits that alleged sections herein are compoundable offence.

Offence under sections 504 & 506 are compoundable offence and trial court has power to compound the offence under section 320 Cr.P.C.
5.
Learned AGA and learned counsel appearing for the opposite party no. 2 have vehemently opposed the submission of learned counsel for the applicants.
6. From the record, it is clear, applicants have filed application before trial court that parties have settled their dispute by making payment and has settled the dispute.
The offence under section 320 Cr.P.C. is compoundable offence.

Trial court is directed that if parties approach with compromise application as they have said to be settled their dispute out of court, trial court after verifying the parties and contents shall decide and compound the offence in terms of compromise within a period of one month from the date of production of certified copy of this order.
7. In view of the above, the present application is disposed of.
